entities.summary: The M. V. Lomonosov School of Electro-technics and Electronics (Bulgarian: Професионална гимназия по електротехника и електроника, is a Bulgarian professional Engineering school and one of the most selective technical schools in Bulgaria. The school is located in Gorna Oryahovitsa.
